name: IC — I2C, SPI — LFCSP
description: Integrated circuit cluster containing surface-mount components in LFCSP packages supporting I2C and SPI communication.
selection_hints: Select when designing surface-mount ICs requiring I2C or SPI control interfaces.
Choose when requiring 32-pin LFCSP packages with 5x5mm body and 0.5mm pitch.
Consider for designs using KiCad symbol entries like ADAU1361 or ADAU1761.
avoid_when: Avoid if the design requires through-hole components rather than surface-mount.
Avoid when packages other than LFCSP are required by board constraints.
Avoid if control interfaces other than I2C or SPI are required.
